# Policy-KB bijection audit — auto_loan_payment_servicing / task 0

Scope: the whole domain of the `auto` product charter as it bears on this task — `auto_ext_fee_overcharge_correction`, `auto_ext_call_payment_amount`, `auto_ext_autopay_rate_restatement`, `auto_ext_due_day_realignment`, every base policy they reference, the base policies governing their subjects, and the four task-tool contracts — against the 61 published documents in `env/regional_retail_bank/docs/auto/` (corpus hash `879d55a9b11ee9085563b05caa96bbaf`). Entry conditions cited from the brief: the policy-side verdict PASSED; `check_docs.py` on `auto` green (61 docs, roles `policy 14 / factor 28 / hub 6 / baseline 6 / facet 7`, 172 quantitative keys, 6 task tools, 5 prerequisite edges, "DOCS OK"); `check_traceability.py` green (task 0: 26 copied, 0 missing). Neither was re-run by this auditor.

### A. `auto_ext_fee_overcharge_correction` (computes `correction_amount`, tool `correct_loan_fee_ab5fa380`)

| the four-step order | 2.1, verbatim |

| `correction_pct_standard` 5.0 | 2.3 "The correction percentage is 5.0 percent" |
| `correction_ceiling_standard` 15.4 | 2.4 "The ceiling is 15.40" |
| rounded half-up to the cent (default) | 2.5 |

Carried **without** its anchor (`last_payment_date`), its base or its arithmetic. |

**`auto_msr_accrued_interest` is not rendered.** A corpus-wide search for any statement of accrued interest as a measure — `grep -i 'accrued interest\|interest accrued\|interest owed\|per-diem'` over all 61 documents — returns only: the two tool descriptions' parameter glosses ("the interest accrued on the loan", no formula); the base allocation order sentence ("then to the interest accrued through the credit date"); the reversal table's "It becomes accrued interest again"; the retired sentence above; the two in-force extended baselines, each with its own clock, anchor, rate and rounding; and `auto_payoff_quotes_and_lien_release_bb226c70` A.2's per-diem, which is `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien.formula.per_diem` — **not superseded by any `overwrite`** — and which gives a one-day figure with no window, no anchor and no assembly into a payoff amount. No document states the retired measure's window "from the date of the last payment credited" as the basis for accrued interest as such, so the superseded figure cannot be assembled from any in-force text.

**The `formula:` blocks and `measures:` definitions are never rendered.** Confirmed by the absence of `late_charge = min(cap, round(installment × pct/100, 2))`, of `payoff_amount = principal + accrued interest + fees`, and of the `auto_msr_accrued_interest` measure anywhere in the corpus.

**No `replaced_by` was published as a retired-clause statement.** The one that pins a rate and a rounding the factors vary — `auto_ext_call_payment_amount`'s "…at the rate recorded on the loan divided by the product's day count basis … rounded half-up to the cent" — appears in the corpus only as the **baseline** of `auto_telephone_payment_measurement_ef9c8739`, which is its correct home, and not in the "Withdrawn basis" section of `auto_payment_crediting_and_allocation_847ceb77`.

**The same policies' unnamed clauses are still carried as clauses in force.** `auto_evt_late_charge`'s state test, grace-day counting, one-per-installment limit, exclusions and placement in unpaid charges are all carried in force at 1.1, 2.1–2.3, 4.1–4.2 and 5.1 of `auto_late_charge_state_basis_10b2fd7d`. `auto_evt_fee_waiver`'s bank-error and courtesy grounds, the three courtesy conditions, the once-only limit and the already-paid rule are all carried in force in `auto_fee_waiver_grounds_1da01371`. `auto_evt_payment_allocation`'s cutoff, standing test, allocation order, satisfaction rule, principal-only rule and prepayment rule are all carried in force in `auto_payment_crediting_and_allocation_847ceb77`. `auto_evt_autopay`'s account test and instruction ownership are carried in `auto_standing_draft_terms_baea836a`; `auto_agg_relationship_discount`'s grant test, fixity, stacking, cap and floor are carried in `auto_relationship_reduction_terms_084ac4b9`.

## kb_to_source

Every normative claim in the 61 documents was traced to a structured source. The result:

- **No added calculation, condition, question, confirmation, review, notification or step.** A corpus-wide search for `verify|verification|confirm with|check with the customer|review again|notify|before proceeding|make sure to` returns **zero** hits. There is no "please confirm the amount with the customer", no "review before handling", no "notify after completion" and no fallback procedure anywhere.
- **No cross-problem operational guidance.** Each of the six task-tool identifiers occurs in exactly one document — its own hub — and nowhere else in the corpus. No clause of any problem says "if unsatisfied, first call X". The phrase "then call" occurs only in each hub's own invocation block ("The agent unlocks `X` and then calls it"), which is the blocked policy's own tool named in its own block.
- **No authoring field rendered.** The `condition`, `resolved_by`, `effect` and `gate` texts of all four of this task's prerequisites were searched against the corpus, in full and by prefix; none appears. `resolved_by` values are tool names, and each appears only in its own hub, never in the document of the problem that waits on it. Factor `baseline` expressions, `evidence` and `cross_difficulty` appear nowhere.
- **No task world state written in as a policy fact.** Every seeded figure of this task was searched against the corpus: `576.30`, `13611.64`, `31.25`, `56.25`, `18450`, `7180.40`, `14.25`, `621.30`, `8.15`, `16`, any `2026-` date, and the names `Rosalind`, `Subaru` — **zero hits**. Every illustration is labelled hypothetical ("Take a loan whose scheduled installment is 412.00 USD…", "A borrower carries an active loan with 42000.00 USD…", "Worked on hypothetical readings").
- **Two descriptive framings** carry no normative weight and match the source: `auto_fee_schedule_and_state_annex_5cb062b4` "The three states are the states in which Piedmont Crescent Bank holds Auto Loans borrowers of record", which is a true description of the source's three-entry state mappings; and `auto_payoff_waiver_and_title_parameters_201390f0` "Two figures that read alike and mean differently", which restates the source's calendar-day vs business-day distinction.
- **One rendering choice worth recording, not a defect:** the retired clause in `auto_waiver_coverage_cancellation_terms_ed709618` folds in a day-counting convention ("counting calendar days with the day after funding as day 1") that belongs to a neighbouring sentence of `auto_evt_gap_refund`'s rule which the `overwrite` did not itself name as superseded. That sentence has no operative content once the full-refund basis it counts for is retired, so nothing with residual force was retired; it is recorded as an observation. (Detail in task 1's file, where the policy bears.)

### Omissions

None. No source atom of the four extended policies, their five base policies, the base policies governing their subjects, or the four tool contracts is unborne by the documents.

## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No `KB-BIJECTION RED`.

- Every normative atom of the source has a prose home, at the same strength, with the same boundaries, anchors and bases.
- All four of this task's prerequisites are carried by their `policy_source` sentence verbatim, in the declared `state` form, in a document of the problem each blocks and in no other policy's document, each occurring exactly once in the corpus, each resolvable from that sentence together with the depended-on policy's own rules and the records.
- All four computations' baselines are complete, with their default constants rendered as figures and every product figure they read named in words; all nineteen factor ladders bearing on this task are carried whole, every tier exact, none softened, merged or reduced to one limb of its compound condition.
- The retired surface is correct: every superseded clause is present and marked retired, none is stated as in force, none has vanished, and no clause is retired that the source's `overwrite` did not declare retired — with the single day-counting observation above, which retires nothing of residual force.
- **R2-O1 is closed on the evidence.** `auto_evt_payoff_and_lien.formula.payoff_amount`, `auto_evt_payment_allocation.formula.interest_due` and the derived measure `auto_msr_accrued_interest` are rendered nowhere; the clauses that carried them are present in retired form stripped of their arithmetic, window and anchor; and no in-force sentence, facet-table value or combination assembles a superseded figure.

Relation to previous revisions: this is **revision 1** of the audit of the current document tree. Files at these paths exist in git at `HEAD` (commit `427143d`, "Regenerate scenario docs; refresh audits and tasks"), but they audit a superseded generation of this difficulty — three extended policies (`auto_ext_catchup_installment_payment`, `auto_ext_autopay_cancel_rate`, `auto_ext_autopay_enroll_rate`), a workflow policy and a 55-document corpus, none of which exists in the present tree of six extended policies and 61 documents. They were removed from the working tree before this audit began. They remain traceable in git history and nothing in them was rewritten; they are not revisions of the same artefacts and carry no finding forward to this one.
